title: Replace the hardcoded trackId:1 literal with the captured track id in two scheduler tests
why: Both files insert a real curriculumTracks row and capture its autoincrement id into a `trackId` local specifically so downstream code can reference the real id — and both then ignore that variable and hardcode `trackId: 1` in the ScheduleConfig/generator.generate() calls that drive the assertions, while still correctly using the captured `trackId` variable a few lines away for the StageDefinitions/CompletionEvents inserts. It works today only because a fresh in-memory DB's first insert is always id 1 (verified: neither seedProfile nor seedProfileZero touch curriculumTracks). If either helper is ever extended to seed a track, or a second track is inserted earlier in a shared setUp, config.trackId/DailyTask.trackId would silently diverge from the row the stages/completions actually reference, and no assertion in either file would catch it since nothing currently checks task.trackId's value.
recommendation: Replace the `trackId: 1` literals with the captured `trackId` variable in both files; add one assertion per file that a produced DailyTask.trackId equals the seeded track's real id, so the variable is load-bearing rather than decorative.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -n 'trackId: 1,'` in both files returns nothing after the fix.
At least one test per file asserts DailyTask.trackId against the captured trackId variable.
